name: @omam/desktop
description: Tarazkar for the macOS menu bar
author: Tarazkar

scripts.package: bun run build && electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg zip --arm64 --publish never
scripts.package:local: bun run build && CSC_IDENTITY_AUTO_DISCOVERY=false electron-builder --config electron-builder.config.ts --mac dmg --arm64 --publish never
scripts.test: bun build src/database.test.ts --target node --format cjs --outfile dist/database-test.cjs && node --test dist/database-test.cjs
scripts.verify: bun build scripts/verify.ts --target node --format esm --external @playwright/test --external electron --outfile dist/verify.mjs && node dist/verify.mjs
